candidates.tagline: Built to outrun Usain Bolt. Forgot to install brakes.
candidates.story: Unitree's 'Superman' humanoid robot hit 12.66 m/s during sprint training for the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing — faster than Usain Bolt's peak speed — then couldn't stop and slammed into a safety cushion, snapping completely at the waist in a shower of sparks, one day before the games officially opened.
candidates.why_funny: The robot nailed the speed goal and completely failed at the 'not destroying itself upon reaching the end of the track' part, prompting the internet to coin 'first career-ending injury in robotic athletics.'
candidates.alt: Unitree Superman humanoid robot bent sharply in half at the waist after crashing into a padded safety barrier during sprint training for the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, torso folded forward over its legs with sparks at the impact point.

candidates.tagline: Apple hid cameras in earbuds so subtle nobody nearby could tell. The internet named them 'PervertPods.'
candidates.story: Apple accidentally leaked new AirPods Pro with hidden cameras in macOS 26.7 RC on August 18, 2026 — the sensors are so small and the earbuds look so normal that people nearby cannot tell you are scanning them; the internet immediately nicknamed them 'PervertPods'; Apple confirmed the product has been delayed to 2027.
candidates.why_funny: Apple's entire design argument for putting cameras in earbuds is that nobody nearby would know the cameras are there — which is precisely what disturbed everyone about them.
candidates.alt: Apple AirPods Pro 2nd generation white earbuds and charging case — the form factor Apple plans to add hidden cameras to in an upcoming version, already dubbed 'PervertPods' by the internet after an accidental macOS beta leak.
